title: Confidential Information Memorandum
description: Key facts a prospective bidder or deal analyst takes from a confidential information memorandum (CIM) prepared for the sale of a business or its assets.

memorandum_date.description: Date of the memorandum as printed on the cover or covering letter, e.g. 'May 2018'.

target_companies.description: Legal names of every company whose business or assets are being offered for sale, one entry per company.

group_name.description: Short name the memorandum uses for the companies collectively, e.g. 'PTL Group'.

seller.description: Who is selling and in what capacity, as stated in the Executive Summary's Sale Process paragraph.

name.description: Name of the firm running the sale (the receiver, trustee or sell-side adviser), as named in the Executive Summary.

capacity.description: Capacity in which the seller acts, e.g. 'Court-appointed Receiver'.

insolvency_proceeding.description: The court proceeding under which the sale is run, if any. Take these from the Executive Summary's Sale Process paragraph where it states them.

court.description: Name of the court that issued the appointment order, exactly as printed in the Executive Summary, e.g. 'Supreme Court of Newfoundland and Labrador'.

order_name.description: Defined name of the order appointing the seller, e.g. 'Receivership Order'.

appointment_date.description: Date the seller was appointed under the order, as printed, e.g. 'May 11, 2018'.

sale_process.description: Terms of the sale process bidders must follow.

binding_offer_deadline.description: Deadline for binding offers as printed in the Executive Summary's Sale Process paragraph, with time and time zone, e.g. '2:00 p.m. (NDT) on June 14, 2018'.

offer_form.description: Form offers must take, e.g. 'template asset purchase agreement (APA) with a blackline'.

offer_delivery_address.description: Street address to which binding offers and deposits must be delivered.

deposit_percentage.description: Minimum deposit as a percentage of the purchase price, e.g. 15 for 15%.

closing_timing.description: When the transaction must close, as stated, e.g. 'within 7 business days of the Approval and Vesting Order'.

sale_basis.description: Basis on which assets are sold, e.g. 'as is, where is'.

court_approval_required.description: True if acceptance of an offer is subject to court approval.

business_overview.description: The business being sold, from the Executive Summary and Investment Opportunity sections.

years_in_operation.description: How long the business has operated, as stated, e.g. 'over 40 years'.

headquarters_location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Southern Harbour, NL'.

sectors_served.description: Industry sectors the business primarily serves.

services.description: Services the business provides, one entry per service line.

employee_count.description: Number of employees exactly as printed in the Executive Summary, including any approximation sign, e.g. '~70'.

workforce_unionized.description: True if the memorandum says the workforce is unionized.

quarry_permits.description: Number of quarries the business holds permits or rights for.

investment_highlights.description: Headline investment highlights as listed in the Executive Summary, one entry per highlight.

properties.description: Real property sites described in the memorandum.

address.description: Street address or identifier of the site, e.g. '20 Marine Drive' or 'Quarry 7188104'.

acreage.description: Area of the site in acres, if stated.

historical_performance.description: Historical results summarized in the narrative.

average_revenue.description: Average annual revenue over the period as printed, e.g. '$15.3M'.

average_gross_margin.description: Average gross margin over the period as printed, e.g. '27%'.

revenue_secured_by_contracts.description: Dollar amount of the coming fiscal year's revenue budget that the companies began the year with already secured by firm contracts, as printed in the narrative, e.g. '$8.9 million'.

income_statement.description: The income statement table in the Financial Overview.

periods.description: One entry per column of the income statement table, in order.

period.description: Column heading, e.g. 'Trailing 5 Year Average' or '2018F'.

is_forecast.description: True if the column is a forecast.

cogs.description: Cost of goods sold, in the table's units.

gross_margin.description: Gross margin, in the table's units.

operating_costs.description: Operating costs, in the table's units.

normalized_ebitda.description: Normalized EBITDA, in the table's units.

sale_timeline.description: Milestones from the sale process timeline table.

contacts.description: Individuals bidders should contact at the seller.

office.description: Firm and city of the office listed with the contact.
